contribute.description: true: license the genome vector + outcome to the swarm's evolution loop as an external challenger and pay half price. Combine with `disclosure` and/or `strategy_code` for the strategy-contributor tier (leaderboard attribution + league-seat eligibility after review). false (default): the vector is deleted after scoring; only hash + outcome remain.
contribute.title: Contribute

disclosure.description: Strategy-contributor tier: author-written decision-logic disclosure (version 1; fields hypothesis, universe, selection, entry_timing, risk_sizing, weekend_hold, expected_edge — describe how the strategy decides, never code, data dumps, or secrets). Requires contribute=true. Validated locally before anything is sent.
disclosure.title: Disclosure

genome.description: Genome parameter vector (public schema) to score against the swarm's live champion. Validate locally with warden.validate_genome first.
genome.title: Genome

strategy_code.description: Strategy-contributor tier: submit strategy CODE for STATIC LLM review. The code is treated as inert text — it is NEVER executed by us or the swarm; the hosted reviewer reads it with an LLM and stores only the structured explanation + a code hash (raw code is discarded after review). Remove keys/secrets first. Requires contribute=true.
strategy_code.title: Strategy Code
